description:
The /tree overlay header was added but is missing bold styling, indentation, and the full structural framing (DynamicBorder + Spacer lines) that upstream wraps the header in.

**IMPLEMENTED (Elixir):**
`render/2` returns plain string `"Session Tree"` as the first line — no bold, no indent.

**EXPECTED (Node.js `TreeSelectorComponent` constructor):**
```
Spacer(1)                          ← one blank line
DynamicBorder                      ← theme.fg("border", "─".repeat(width))
Text(theme.bold("  Session Tree")) ← bold, 2-space indent, 1-line top margin
TruncatedText(theme.fg("muted", "  ↑/↓: move..."))  ← see opi-ce3.2
SearchLine                         ← see opi-ce3.3
DynamicBorder                      ← theme.fg("border", "─".repeat(width))
Spacer(1)                          ← one blank line
[tree entries]                     ← see TreeList.render
Spacer(1)                          ← one blank line
DynamicBorder                      ← theme.fg("border", "─".repeat(width))
```

**Gaps:**
1. Header string is plain — should be `Theme.bold("  Session Tree")` (bold + 2-space indent)
2. No `DynamicBorder` (horizontal rule) above/below the header block or at the bottom of the overlay
3. No `Spacer` blank lines before the first border or after the last border
4. All structural chrome (borders, spacers) is missing from `TreeSelector.render/2`

**Where to fix:**
`apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/tree_selector.ex` — `render/2` should emit border + spacer lines matching the upstream structure. `DynamicBorder` equivalent is `Theme.fg(theme, :border, String.duplicate("─", width))`.
title: opi-277.1: /tree missing header title
